description: Read-only: fetches current cash, buying power, and account value from the signed-in user's saved broker connection. For current performance of a named bot or a follow-up about its account, use show_bot_activity first; it performs its own exact-linked broker read. Use this tool after that report for a failed or stale current read, not as a preflight before the report. Standalone account questions and trade-sizing reads still use this tool normally. For a trade sized from all cash, all buying power, or a percentage of an account, first resolve one exact active saved connection and pass its brokerCredentialId. Use that same credential for the quote and place_trade approval because quantity depends on the selected account. Do not aggregate balances across accounts for one order. This reads the broker directly through the broker-data Lambda and never returns account numbers, broker tokens, or runtime secret ids.
name: get_broker_account_snapshot
title: Get broker account snapshot
